description: This file defines the class Opencart.Admin.Model.Cms.Topic, which manages CRUD operations and related data handling for blog or content topics within the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving topics, descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, and caches.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: A model class handling CRUD operations and data management for CMS topics within the OpenCart admin module, including descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, layouts, and cache interactions.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Creates a new topic entry, including its descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and invalidates the relevant cache.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates an existing topic and its related data such as descriptions, store links, and SEO URLs, then clears cache.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Removes a topic and all its related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and clears cache.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data of a specific topic, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches a list of topics with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, with caching support.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topics in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description for a particular topic in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language, across topics.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a particular topic, grouped by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs linked to a specific topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a topic for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a given article ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout associations by layout ID.
